title: KNOBLOCH Information Group, BEN, and Skye Inteligencia LATAM Form Skye Salud to Modernize Healthcare in Mexico with Sovereign AI
summary: BEN’s commercial-ready AI solutions deliver human-like responses using natural language, combined with the ability to remember customer details and problem solve in real-time on mobile devices, computers and stand-alone kiosks.
body_markdown: **About Brand Engagement Network, Inc. (BEN)** : Brand Engagement Network, Inc. (Nasdaq:[BNAI](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/knobloch-information-group-ben-and-skye-inteligencia-latam-form-skye-salud-to-modernize-healthcare-in-mexico-with-sovereign-ai-302639146.html?tc=eml_cleartime#financial-modal) ) develops conversational AI agents for regulated industries. Its ELM™ with retrieval-augmented generation powers multimodal, compliance-focused AI across chat, voice, avatar, and digital channels. With 21 issued patents and adoption in life sciences, healthcare, insurance, financial services, hospitality, retail, and automotive, BEN remains at the forefront of enterprise AI and regulatory standards. Visit[www.beninc.ai](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4577647-1&h=1027772853&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.beninc.ai%2F&a=www.beninc.ai) .
